requirement.text: Each thermostat shall have a unique identifier by which that thermostat is identified in the THEMAS system.

classification.rationale: The requirement specifies unique identification for thermostat hardware/IoT devices within the THEMAS system. This describes an embedded/IoT or generic system rather than a web application, mobile application, or AI-driven system.

rounds.text_checked: Each thermostat shall have a unique identifier by which that thermostat is identified in the THEMAS system.

test_strategy.rationale: The requirement mandates that each thermostat have a unique identifier. Equivalence partitioning applies by dividing the input domain into classes of valid unique identifiers and invalid or duplicate identifiers.

test_cases.title: Register Thermostat with Unique Identifier
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is active and no thermostat with identifier 'THERM-001' is registered.
steps: Provision a new thermostat with identifier 'THERM-001'.
Register the thermostat in the THEMAS system.
Query THEMAS for the thermostat using identifier 'THERM-001'.
test_cases.expected_result: The thermostat is successfully registered and uniquely retrieved by identifier 'THERM-001'.

test_cases.title: Attempt Registration of Thermostat with Duplicate Identifier
test_cases.preconditions: A thermostat with identifier 'THERM-001' is already registered in the THEMAS system.
steps: Attempt to register a second thermostat using the same identifier 'THERM-001'.
test_cases.expected_result: Registration fails and THEMAS rejects the second thermostat due to duplicate identifier restriction.

test_cases.title: Register Multiple Thermostats with Distinct Unique Identifiers
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is active with no conflicting identifiers present.
test_cases.expected_result: Both thermostats are successfully registered and uniquely identifiable, returning distinct status and details for each.

final_text: Each thermostat shall have a unique identifier by which that thermostat is identified in the THEMAS system.
